archive.method: git archive exact frozen commit; fresh base; complete source/agent refresh and optional SSH packages plus explicit Krea Turbo patch on immutable v0.3.14 runtime parents

explicitRuntimeChanges: openssh-server and rsync installed in base and runtime refresh
new entrypoint copied from exact source; missing PUBLIC_KEY means no SSH listener
AI Toolkit variants apply only committed 0004-Krea-2-Turbo-samples.patch; prior three REPA patches and CUDA/Python GPU environments retained
captioning Dockerfile changes EXPOSE 8000 to EXPOSE 8000 22; vLLM installation bytes inherited
runtimeReuseProof.updatedSource: entire agent venv, source packages, shared pod scripts including reviewed checkpoint selection repair, entrypoint and v2 table copied from fresh exact-source base

buildMethod: Fresh exact-source base; replace complete agent environment/source/program trees on immutable v0.3.14 runtime parents; add openssh-server and rsync; apply only Krea Turbo patch 0004 to AI Toolkit variants. Existing Python GPU runtime packages are inherited unchanged.
oldAgentLayerOverhead: Prior agent layer remains in inherited runtime layers; its environment and source trees are deleted before copying fresh replacements, so old packages and removed files cannot execute.
captioningLayerReuse: Existing immutable captioning runtime parents retain identical vLLM bytes; the new flag checker verifies the installed vLLM before publication.
